title: Moore to Mealy keeps the states
notes: A parity bit: e writes 0 while the number of 1s read is even, o writes 1 when it is odd. Each move into o now writes 1 and each move into e writes 0. Same two states, and the Mealy machine writes one symbol fewer.
ops: start e; e / 0; o / 1; e 0 -> e; e 1 -> o; o 0 -> o; o 1 -> e
